group_assessment.counts_note: total_publications and publications_on_gene are 0 because no per-author output count was measured in this pass. A zero here means NOT MEASURED, not zero publications.
group_assessment.note: Research-group knowledge base excluded from the public edition; this rests on measured PubMed counts and the paper's own author and reference lists.
group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-10-02 (tool=LEGEND-research): 'WWOX AND TIAF1' 9 records and 'WWOX AND TIAF1 NOT Chang NS[au]' 0 records; '"TRAPPC6A" AND (aggregation OR plaque)' 4 records, all four from this laboratory; 'Zfra' 17 records and 'Zfra NOT Chang NS[au]' 1 record, which is an unrelated zebrafish androgen-receptor paper matching the string by accident; 'WWOX AND "dorsal root ganglion"' 1 record, the group's own.
group_assessment.self_citation_measured: Of this paper's 53 references all 53 carry a PMID and 11 have Chang NS as an author (21 percent) - the least self-referential paper in group B.
group_assessment.weighting: Same laboratory, earlier and broader bibliography. The directional claim it makes - WWOX activation as pro-death in injured neurons - cuts against the protective framing of the 2015-2022 papers, which makes it the most informative record in the group and the one with no independent replication at all.

ONE DEPENDENCY IS FLAGGED: reference 52, the 2005 PNAS report of WWOX gene restoration in lung cancer, carries a 2017 editorial expression of concern (PMID 28373548), and is cited here for background only.

flagged.citing_relation: citation only, background. Reference 52 is cited once, in a Discussion sentence listing prior reports that ectopic WWOX kills cancer cells ("Similar observations were shown in lung cancer A549 and H460 cells"). No reagent, cell line, method, construct or datum of this paper comes from it, and no result of this paper changes if that reference is withdrawn. The JATS deposit carries the expression-of-concern pointer on that reference element itself, which is how it was found; the citing article is not itself flagged.

entries.proposition: THE PAPER'S OWN SIZE DEFINITION IS PURELY MORPHOMETRIC. 'Small' means under 20 micrometres in diameter and nothing else; the words 'nociceptive', 'unmyelinated', 'IB4', 'CGRP' and 'substance P' do not occur in the artefact. Any reading of this paper as a statement about nociceptors is imported convention, not the authors'.

entries.proposition: THE HEADLINE CO-ACTIVATION IS NOT LATERALISED. The paper's own sentence places it in the uninjured side as well as the injured one, which removes axotomy as the sufficient cause of the chronic phase it names in the title.

entries.proposition: FIGURE ATTESTATION quantifying the sentence above. Supplementary Figure S3 gives the numbers: at month 2 the contralateral uninjured side reaches about 72 percent of small neurons with nuclear p-WOX1 against about 71 percent ipsilateral, and sham animals already sit at 37 percent contralateral and 31 percent ipsilateral. The chronic 'axotomy-induced' accumulation is therefore indistinguishable between the operated and the unoperated ganglion.

entries.proposition: THE DIRECTIONAL CLAIM IS A CELL-LINE REPORTER RESULT, NOT A NEURONAL MEASUREMENT. The promoter assays that supply 'WOX1 inhibits CREB and enhances NF-kB' were run by transient overexpression in a human embryonic kidney line with Gal4-fusion reporters.

FIGURE ATTESTATION qualifying the sentence above. Figure 5 shows the Gal4 schematic and the reporter bars; no panel of it contains a neuron. The in-neuron work in this paper is binding (FRET in primary DRG cultures, immuno-EM in tissue), never transcriptional output.

entries.proposition: FIGURE ATTESTATION qualifying the death figure. Supplementary Figure S1's TUNEL panel at 60 days is qualitative: two arrowed cells in one ipsilateral field, an inset, and no counting panel anywhere in the figure. The paper's 'less than 5%' is therefore a text assertion with no counted panel behind it, and the Nissl series shows the morphological changes it describes without quantification either.
